boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, officially listed Stanford Libraries study environments, spanning quiet reading rooms, collaborative areas, and specialized workspaces.

cards.title: Albert M. Bender Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cecil H. Green Library · Room 500
cards.notes: Set up with a reading assignment or a long writing block; the library lists this room as quiet, naturally lit, and furnished with soft seating.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Green Library reading room with natural light and soft seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Libraries lists the Albert M. Bender Reading Room in Green Library as a quiet space with natural light and soft seating; no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stanford University Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Stanford Libraries states that Stanford ID is required for library entry.

cards.title: Government Documents Study Area
cards.subtitle: Cecil H. Green Library · Room B05
cards.notes: Bring work that benefits from a large shared surface; this quiet study area includes a monitor and a 70-by-96-inch table.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lower-level Green Library workspace with a monitor and oversized table.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Libraries lists the Government Documents Study Area, Room B05 in Green Library, as quiet and equipped with a monitor and a 70-by-96-inch table; no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stanford University Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Stanford Libraries states that Stanford ID is required for library entry.

cards.title: Hohbach Hall Study Area
cards.subtitle: Cecil H. Green Library · Room 116
cards.notes: Use the large table, monitor, whiteboard, and soft seating to spread out a collaborative task or map out a study plan.
cards.short_summary: A flexible Green Library study area with daylight, a monitor, whiteboard, and soft seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Libraries lists Hohbach Hall Study Area, Room 116 in Green Library, with conversation space, a large table, monitor, natural light, soft seating, and a whiteboard; no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stanford University Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Stanford Libraries states that Stanford ID is required for library entry.

cards.title: Jonsson Social Sciences Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cecil H. Green Library · Room 107
cards.notes: Choose this reading room for quiet work with daylight; its listed equipment includes a monitor, large table, and high-resolution scanner.
cards.short_summary: A quiet social-sciences reading room with daylight, scanning, and a large table.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Libraries lists the Jonsson Social Sciences Reading Room, Room 107 in Green Library, as quiet and naturally lit, with soft seating, a monitor, a large table, and a high-resolution scanner; no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stanford University Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Stanford Libraries states that Stanford ID is required for library entry.

cards.title: Lane Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cecil H. Green Library · Room 207
cards.notes: Plan for focused reading or drafting in this quiet room, where the listed setup pairs natural light and soft seating with a monitor and large table.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, naturally lit Green Library reading room with a monitor and large table.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Libraries lists the Lane Reading Room, Room 207 in Green Library, as quiet and naturally lit, with a monitor, soft seating, and a 70-by-96-inch table; no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stanford University Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Stanford Libraries states that Stanford ID is required for library entry.

cards.title: Media & Microtext Study Area
cards.subtitle: Cecil H. Green Library · Room 73
cards.notes: Bring media-heavy coursework here: the listed features include a multimedia station, scanner, natural light, quiet setting, and soft seating.
cards.short_summary: A Green Library study area combining quiet seating with multimedia and scanning tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Libraries lists the Media & Microtext Study Area, Room 73 in Green Library, with a multimedia station, natural light, quiet, a scanner, and soft seating; no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stanford University Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Stanford Libraries states that Stanford ID is required for library entry.

cards.title: Raubitschek Study Area
cards.subtitle: Cecil H. Green Library · Room 351
cards.notes: For a small-team session, use the 4-to-8-person area’s large table, large monitor, whiteboard, natural light, and quiet designation.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Green Library area for small-group work with a large monitor and whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanford Libraries lists the Raubitschek Study Area, Room 351 in Green Library, for 4–8 people and with a large table, large monitor, natural light, quiet, and a whiteboard; no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Places to study | Stanford University Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Stanford Libraries states that Stanford ID is required for library entry.
